# Sweet Escape Memphis

> Sweet Escape is a locally owned ice cream shop at 1674 Whitten Rd, Suite 106, Memphis, Tennessee 38134. The shop serves hand-dipped ice cream, self-serve frozen yogurt, gelato, sorbet, milkshakes, cookie ice cream sandwiches, ice cream nachos, and other specialty desserts.

Canonical website: https://www.sweetescapememphis.com/
Complete XML sitemap: https://www.sweetescapememphis.com/sitemap.xml
Complete item directory: https://www.sweetescapememphis.com/item-directory.html
Live menu and current availability: https://www.sweetescapememphis.com/stock.html
